discrepancy_fixed: The build log's 'Generating static pages (N/N)' counter read 4 for a 2-route build and routes+2 in the later builds (3 routes -> 5, 5 routes -> 7), contradicting both the html-file count and the Route (app) table; the rule was verified against the Route (app) table instead of the counter.
file_to_url: strip out/ prefix and .html suffix: index.html => '/', top.html => '/top', nested/page.html => '/nested/page', blog/hello-world.html => '/blog/hello-world'. Exclude 404.html and _not-found.html (duplicate not-found aliases), all *.txt (RSC payloads), _next/** (asset chunks), and public/ copies (favicon.ico, *.svg).
gotchas: Next 16 static export emits nested routes as flat foo.html (out/top.html, out/nested/page.html), not foo/index.html -- a **/index.html rule finds only out/index.html and misses every nested page.
Every route also emits a same-named .txt RSC payload (index.txt, top.txt, nested/page.txt, blog/hello-world.txt); counting *.txt or all files double-counts each page.
Internal __next.*.txt files live inside route-named directories (out/top/__next._full.txt, out/blog/hello-world/__next.blog.$d$slug.__PAGE__.txt); only the .html at the matching path is a page.
out/404.html is byte-identical to out/_not-found.html (verified with diff) -- a duplicate alias for static hosts, not a second page; exclude both.
Route groups vanish from out/: app/(marketing)/promo/page.tsx emitted out/promo.html with no (marketing) directory; the group name survives only URL-encoded inside internal __next.*.txt filenames.

The build log's 'Generating static pages (N/N)' counter equals route count + 2 in all three builds (2 routes -> 4, 3 routes -> 5, 5 routes -> 7), not the route count; verify against the Route (app) table, not the counter.
Dynamic routes materialize one .html per generateStaticParams entry (blog/hello-world.html); N slugs = N counted pages, listed as concrete paths under the [slug] entry in the route table.
public/ files (favicon.ico, file.svg, globe.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg, window.svg) are copied to out/ root and are not pages; _next/static/** chunks are never pages.
second_source_of_truth: build log Route (app) table (cross-checked against hand count of page.tsx files under app/)
